Refresh on EVERY webphone relock whose delta touches internal/server/hooks/ (relock ritual gate 5): update this file, the field-for-field test in tests/test_ringhook.py follows it, and the dialplan template (modules/freeswitch.nix, the mod_curl post body) must be re-diffed against it.
_doc_example_trap: webphone's own doc example shows a `secret` BODY key; the struct has none — auth is the Authorization: Bearer header only. This shim signs with the header; a secret must never ride the fact body.

fields.owner: string - the ringing extension (digits; the dialplan renders ${number})
fields.from: string - the caller id the PBX reports (dialplan renders ${caller_id_number})
fields.call_id: string - opaque foreign token (the PBX call uuid, correlated verbatim by the shell)

ack_semantics: 202 for every well-formed fact (inert when the push seam is off; per-device push failures log and continue); 400 when state is neither ring nor end; unknown JSON fields are DROPPED silently upstream (Go decoder) - the shim forwards the fact verbatim and must stay a dumb pipe
